conversation.text:
Police: I’m on my way right now. Keep talking and don’t hang up. What happened?
Respondent: My mom called me.
Respondent: Xiyuan’s grandmother—she said she was at the supermarket in front of the residential complex, but the security guard called saying the fire alarm in her home went off.
Respondent: The security guard was worried there was a fire and was going to check her home, but he couldn’t open the door. My mom wanted me to go over and help open it.
Respondent: I told her I couldn’t leave Xiyuan alone and asked her to hurry back herself.
Respondent: But she insisted that I go...
Respondent: She said she would arrive soon and would pick up the child at the amusement park, and told me to go upstairs to take a look and then come right back down.
Respondent: She said the timing would be just right, and that she would wait downstairs with the child.
Respondent: I went to my mom’s home and found the security guard indeed waiting at the door, so I opened it. I don’t know what she left in the pot, but when we went in, it had already burned dry and the room was filled with smoke.
Respondent: The security guard helped turn off the gas and open the windows for ventilation.
Respondent: At that moment, I was thinking how lucky it was that I hadn’t brought the child upstairs. Otherwise, breathing in so much smoke would definitely be bad for her health. Fortunately, the house didn’t catch fire... Then I hurriedly took the elevator down.
Respondent: It was only a few minutes, but...
Respondent: When I came down, my mom was indeed standing downstairs as we had agreed.
Respondent: I asked her where Xiyuan was.
Respondent: She told me, wasn’t Xiyuan taken upstairs by you?
Respondent: Officer Quan, when will you arrive?
